1. Local receptive fields and weight sharing (tied filters).
2. $z_1=1\cdot 2+(-1)\cdot 0=2$.
3. The same pattern (e.g. an edge) can appear anywhere; reuse parameters and keep the model small.
4. Replaces each $2\times 2$ block by its maximum, shrinking spatial size.
5. Conv $\to$ activation $\to$ pool (repeat) $\to$ flatten/global-pool $\to$ dense head.
